messages:
emily-support: Morning — Acme reporting a spike of 401s against our webhook receiver after a scheduled rotation around 2026-02-15 00:12 UTC. Can someone triage?
acme-integrations: yes, we saw failures at ~00:15. Our side logs HMAC mismatch for Webhook-ID: acme-42. No config changes on our end.
emily-support: marking P1 and assigning @raj.
raj-engineer: on it. Can you paste a sample failing headers + payload and confirm if rotation swapped key_id or only rewrapped the secret?
acme-integrations: header X-Partner-KeyID: 4b8a-1c9d
header X-Partner-Sig: sha256=ab12f3...
payload same as previous deliveries.
raj-engineer: checking Vault/rotation job history — rotation ran at 00:10 UTC and wrote a new secret version for partners/acme-42 with key_id=9f2d-7b33. DB updated to point at new version.
raj-engineer: verifier logs: HMAC verify failed — expected sha256=3f9e..., got sha256=ab12f3... header used key_id 4b8a-1c9d.
vinh-sre: that smells like cache staleness. We cache key_id -> secret mapping in redis plus partners.keys table. If cache wasn't invalidated, verifier might read new DB row but incoming header is still referencing old key id that partner continues to sign with until they refresh.
raj-engineer: confirmed: redis still returns mapping partner:acme-42:key_id -> 4b8a-1c9d (version=1). Rotation job updated DB to version=2 with key_id 9f2d-7b33 but rotation pipeline didn't publish a cache eviction. Cache TTL is 1h, so mismatch window opened.
emily-support: note: rotation job updates Vault + DB but forgot cache eviction hook. Ops pipeline bug.
ops-bot: deploy: rotation-job-v2 succeeded 2026-02-15T00:11:20Z; cache-invalidate hook not configured. :warning: 
raj-engineer: repro steps I used:
1) curl -XPOST http://internal-ops/rotate?partner=acme-42 to trigger rotation job
2) vault kv get -field=key secret/data/partners/acme-42
3) redis-cli GET partner:acme-42:key_id -> returns old id
Sample verifier (node):
```
const secret = getSecretForKeyId(keyId); // backend lookup
const expected = crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(payload).digest('hex');
if (`sha256=${expected}` !== sigHeader) throw new Error('HMAC mismatch');
```
raj-engineer: root cause: partner continued signing with old key_id until they polled metadata. Our rotation updated DB to new key but redis cache still had old mapping -> verifier used wrong secret vs header key_id.
vinh-sre: mitigation options:
- Fast rollback: restore Vault version=1 and point DB at version=1 (fast but negates rotation).
- Safer: push a metadata refresh notification to the partner and implement a dual-key verify fallback that accepts previous key for a short grace window. Also add cache eviction into rotation pipeline.
raj-engineer: pushed hotfix to webhook-verifier: when header key_id doesn't match current mapping, attempt a historical lookup for previous key versions for a 10m grace. Rolling out now.
```
kubectl -n webhooks set image deploy/webhook-verifier webhook-verifier:v20260215-hotfix
```
acme-integrations: we'll accept a refresh-notice; we poll every 30m so a push would help recover faster.
emily-support: sending rotation-notice to Acme asking them to refresh metadata and retry pending webhooks.
ops-bot: rollout complete — webhook-verifier v20260215-hotfix deployed 00:37 UTC.
raj-engineer: after hotfix, verification success for acme-42 resumed ~00:38. 401 rate dropped from ~43% to ~1.2%.
emily-support: action items:
- Add cache invalidation hook to rotation job and emit partner notification event (PR: github.com/redwood/ops/pull/512).
- Implement dual-key grace acceptance in verifier (RFC in #eng-security).
- Add runbook steps for Vault version rollback and rotation troubleshooting (runbook/rotation.md).
vinh-sre: opened infra ticket to add redis pubsub eviction step to rotation pipeline (OPS-982).
acme-integrations: reprocessed backlog and backfilled; all good now, thanks for the fast turnaround.
emily-support: closing thread, tracking follow-ups in OPS-982. :thumbsup:
